name: Las Vegas, NV
subtitle: Celebrity chefs and strip legends — the full table
items: Joël Robuchon at MGM Grand (the $500+ tasting menu — bucket list)
Guy Savoy at Caesars Palace (3-star Paris legend's Vegas outpost)
é by José Andrés (Cosmopolitan, 8-seat counter, Spain's avant-garde)
Bazaar Meat by José Andrés (SLS, the steak experience)
Bouchon (Venetian, Thomas Keller's bistro — best eggs Benedict on the strip)
CUT by Wolfgang Puck (Venetian, best steakhouse on strip)
Spago (Bellagio, Wolfgang Puck's original Vegas room)
Carbone at Aria (Italian-American theater, try the spicy rigatoni)
Momofuku at Cosmopolitan (David Chang, fried chicken + steamed buns)
Nobu at Caesars (the OG celebrity Japanese)
Le Cirque at Bellagio (French, lakeside — the old guard at its best)
Lago by Julian Serrano (Bellagio, Italian, overlooking the fountains)
Wicked Spoon Buffet at Cosmopolitan (RIP)
Lotus of Siam (East Flamingo — the best Thai in North America, not a joke)
Tacos El Gordo (Tijuana-style, multiple locations — open late)
Hash House A Go Go (Sahara, towers of farm food + massive portions)
Ferraro's Italian (Paradise, since 1985, locals only know)
In-N-Out Burger (Strip location — 24-hour drive-thru on the Strip itself)
Eggslut at Cosmopolitan (the hangover cure)
Carson Kitchen (Downtown, Cory Harwell)
